policies.sentence: Students may use AI to explain, clarify and ask questions about course concepts and material.
Students may use AI to explain code, syntax, language features and error messages.
Students may use AI to get example programs and review examples to learn from.
The instructor encourages students to use AI to deepen understanding and review challenging material.
Students may use AI only for learning concepts, not for other course work.
Students must not use AI to summarize or contextualize assigned readings and source materials.
Students must not use AI as a tutor or to discuss concepts.
